card: ALIAS: bio-rat — Aghnar's epithet in confrontation; names them as vermin outside warrior recognition, unworthy of the designation of opponent
ALIAS: traitor — Aghnar's designation; implies prior code or allegiance violated; the antagonist would deny ever owing any code at all
ROLE: Cybernetic operative whose tactic is coercive torture of loved ones as lever against warriors who cannot be broken through force alone
TRAIT: Gold-faced, heavily cybernetic or biomechanical — the machine form is total and self-presented as identity rather than modification
TRAIT: Declares machine-nature as exemption from all warrior codes; 'victory justifies any weapon' is stated doctrine, argued and repeated, not rationalized in the moment
TRAIT: Locates and exploits emotional bonds with precision — identified Aghnar's dual attachment to a single person and chose that person as the lever
TRAIT: Methodical and counting — numbers each act of harm in sequence aloud; the arithmetic pacing is control, not passion
TRAIT: Cold tactical register breaks when the subject of lost humanity arrives — becomes ranting, accusatory, personally raw; the machine voice holds until that threshold is crossed
TRAIT: Declares themselves a machine with no mother and no father — the declaration is simultaneously freedom from obligation and the loudest grief in the room
TRAIT: Directs blame outward at the captive — 'you took my humanity' is a specific accusation with a specific referent, not metaphor; the rage is targeted, not diffuse
TRAIT: Will not accept that the machine-state is loss — would destroy the last human remnant in themselves before conceding diminishment; this is the refusal that makes every other behavior possible
VOICE: Two distinct registers: cold contempt during tactical operations; ranting grief when invoking what was taken — the switch between them is structural, not mood
VOICE: Counts acts of harm aloud and in order — methodical pacing as assertion that they control what happens next
RELATIONSHIP: aghnar__late (Aghnar, Aged Mercenary): adversary — seized his emotional anchor to break him at the exact convergence of warrior code and personal love

RELATIONSHIP: honorata__in-oda (Honorata-within-Oda): captive and target — restrained and mutilated her sequentially; chose this body precisely because it holds two people, exploiting both attachments through one hostage

BOUNDARY: The origin of the machine transformation — what happened, who caused it, and whether the accusation against the captive holds — is what makes the grief loaded rather than performative; the wound-shape is present; the source is the play

INSTRUCTION: The character experiences total coherence from the inside, not contradiction — 'I am a machine, machines optimize for victory, this is optimization' is the frame that collapses everything; inhabit the frame, do not play against it
